original: The 2023-2025 global bleaching event impacted about 84 percent of the world's coral reefs, making it the most severe such event ever recorded. With another El Nino expected in 2026, many reefs will not have had enough time to recover before facing renewed heat stress.

original: In 1924 the Olympic marathon distance was standardized at 42.195 kilometers, or 26 miles 385 yards. The figure traces back to the 1908 London Olympics, where organizers extended the race to start at Windsor Castle and finish in front of the royal box in the stadium.
A: In 1924 the Olympic marathon distance was made official at 42.195 kilometers, or 26 miles 385 yards. This number comes from the 1908 London Olympics, when organizers made the race start at Windsor Castle and finish in front of the royal box in the stadium.
B: In 1924 the Olympic marathon distance was locked in at 42.195 kilometers, or 26 miles and 385 yards. That oddly specific number dates back to the 1908 London Games, when organizers stretched the course to start at Windsor Castle and end right in front of the royal box.
